notes.title: Linux & Mac: Steam Play: Verified for Apolune
notes.content:
Thanks to @LinuxGameCons & [url=https://linuxgameconsortium.com/]LinuxGamingConsortium [/url] we've verified that, indeed, Apolune runs just fine on these platforms via SteamPlay.

So, if you have a Linux or Macintosh computer, Steam Play will work for you!

Find out more here:

[url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=9439-QHKN-1308]Steam Play Documentation[/url]


See the article about Apolune on Linux Gaming Consortium's webzine:

[url=https://linuxgameconsortium.com/linux-gaming-news/apolune-developer-views-native-support-78499/]Apolune developer views on native support[/url]

notes.title: Post-Launch Update #1
notes.content:
In post-launch update #1, the following changes have been made:

[list]
[*] Fix to horrible random crash issue in "quad tree collider" after 50 kills
[*] Added "mines" at kill count 150, on Right CTRL Key to player 1
[*] Add deflector field that uses stamina once stamina is gained
[*] Tweaked stamina allowances
[*] Changed the way that the ram/dodge effect works slightly to increase number of times it can be used as you progress
[*] Made it possible to survive beyond 1000 kills
[*] Changed the way support fleets work.  Previously if you destroyed a ship with launchable ships, they died and you got no reward.  Fighters now launch from their destroyed ship with damage already accrued.
[*] Added tinge to bullets in cheater mode so people can be less able to claim they weren't cheating when they were in videos and screenshots
[*] Added new sounds to new features and stamina-related features
[/list]

This version will go live at 6:30pm EST today, Feb 8 2019.

notes.title: Cheat Codes revealed on SGJ Podcast #277
notes.content:
Watch and listen to the podcast here to learn tips, tricks and the cheat codes:  https://youtu.be/5Q1lXqZC7Cw?t=1577

Thanks again to Brian, Jim, Hunter and Spaz!  It was a lot of fun.

[b]Soft Launch[/b] right in the middle of the Lunar New Year Sale!  Feb 6, why wait, buy this game now during the discount!  

Officially launching Feb 13, we hope to have leaderboards working soon if they aren't after launch.  Compete against yourself and your friends by achieving a high score.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34374793/a79a97a8bf6de7bc73b769ff6284ef96be833475.gif[/img]

Also, keep in mind there [b][i]is[/i][/b] a second player activated during the first 30 kills, when you hit Y or U keys, or use the Steam Controller profile that supports Player 2 controls (FTGH JIKL YU keys)

By playing with a second player you will have your score recorded to the "2 Player" leaderboard variations.

Happy hunting!

Notes about cheat codes:

[list]
[*] You will gain some achievements from using them.
[*] You won't have your score recorded to the global leaderboards.
[*] You will enjoy them, and can always go back to not cheating.
[/list]

notes.title: Apolune to be featured on Space Game Junkie podcast
notes.content:
Brian Rubin, Jim and Hunter will be featuring the developer and game Apolune in a podcast coming around our [b]February 13th[/b] launch date.  (Soft launch on [b]February 6![/b]) For those of you who take advantage of the early adopter discount (launching discount), enjoy the game and then tune into Space Game Junkie to learn more about the game, how it came about, and tips on the best ways to beat your last score.

And for you true Space Game Junkies, get insider information on the Cheaters Paradise feature, which will be announced exclusively during the podcast.  We'll update our news here on Steam once the podcast is released.

Happy hunting!
